changelog.note: v1.6：进口日期下限 2026-09-15（更早日期自动抬到下限并提示）；完税价格与运输方式移入「其他税费」卡片即时算 MPF/HMF；英文版全英文——引擎每条说明/条件/替代方案双语生成，数据表 841 条中文字段经 data/modules/i18n/en.csv 词典补英文（scripts/i18n_en.py），语言纯度扫描 scripts/lang_audit.mjs 英文版 0 处中文。
changelog.note_en: v1.6: entry-date floor 2026-09-15 (earlier dates are lifted to the floor with a notice); entered value and transport mode moved into the "Fees" card for instant MPF / HMF; English mode fully English — every engine line, condition and alternative is generated in both languages, 841 Chinese data fields carry English twins from the data/modules/i18n/en.csv dictionary (scripts/i18n_en.py), and the language-purity scan scripts/lang_audit.mjs finds no Chinese in English mode.

changelog.note: v1.5.1：改进口日期 / 原产国 / 申报情形后自动重新计算（此前须再点「查询」）；进口日期落在 IEEPA（2025-02-04～2026-02-20）或 Section 122（2026-02-24～07-23）期间时顶部显示警告：该期间税率未收录、合计不含。
changelog.note_en: v1.5.1: recomputes automatically when the entry date / origin / claims change (previously the Lookup button had to be pressed again); a warning is shown when the entry date falls within the IEEPA (2025-02-04 – 2026-02-20) or Section 122 (2026-02-24 – 07-23) periods: those rates are not covered and not in the total.

changelog.note: v1.5：(1) HTS 换版工具 scripts/hts/hts_update.py（parse / diff / apply：新版 PDF 解析、增删改与统计号改号映射、各模块清单存在性核对）；(2) IRS 联邦消费税模块（报关代征 016/017/018/022 费率与 CBMA 退税、Form 720 制造商税；106 行）；(3) 关税配额标记（配额内/外税率线自动配对 631 行 + 16 个配额项目）；(4) FCC Covered List 逐条（16 条实体/品类 + 6 条授权规则 + 3 条拟议）按税号提示。
changelog.note_en: v1.5: (1) HTS revision tool scripts/hts/hts_update.py (parse / diff / apply: new-revision PDF parsing, additions / removals / changes with statistical-line renumbering map, existence check of every module list); (2) IRS federal excise module (entry-collected classes 016 / 017 / 018 / 022 with CBMA refunds, Form 720 manufacturer taxes; 106 rows); (3) tariff-rate-quota marking (631 in-/over-quota line pairs + 16 quota programs); (4) FCC Covered List entry by entry (16 entity / category entries + 6 authorization rules + 3 proposed) shown by HTS code.

changelog.note: v1.4：更新机制——新增「数据源与复核节奏」表（30 项：模块 × 数据源 × 频率 × 关键字 × 上次核对 × 负责），数据页按节奏显示到期状态；配套每周自动扫描任务（FR 总统公告 / USTR / CSMS / USITC 修订 / UFLPA 实体清单）。
changelog.note_en: v1.4: update mechanism — new "sources & re-verification cadence" table (30 items: module × source × frequency × keywords × last verified × owner), with due status shown on the Data page; paired with a weekly automatic scan (FR presidential documents / USTR / CSMS / USITC revisions / UFLPA Entity List).

v1.3: Canada 338 September changes loaded — Proc. 11064/11065 (91 FR 58331/58339, effective 2026-09-15): alcohol list +34 / −2, "motor vehicle" list +76 / −8 (including 12 re-listed 10-digit lines, the 122 CBP refers to), 9903.03.12 / .14 now stack on 232 and only the dairy list 9903.03.13 keeps 9903.03.15; Proc. 11061/11062/11063 (91 FR 58311/58319/58325, effective 2026-09-29): 68 lines prohibited, marked "import prohibited" on the site. Lists taken from the White House annex text layer and reconciled with CSMS #69851916.

changelog.note: v1.2：中文品名层——中国税则 12,030 个 10 位编码中文品名按 HS 6 位挂接（第 1–97 章 5,614 个 6 位全部覆盖）；支持中文品名搜索 → 6 位 → 美国 10 位展开；结果页与展开列表显示中国税则同 6 位品名。
changelog.note_en: v1.2: Chinese product-name layer — 12,030 China Customs 10-digit descriptions attached at the HS-6 level (all 5,614 HS-6 codes of chapters 1–97 covered); Chinese name search → HS-6 → U.S. 10-digit expansion; the results page and expansion list show the Chinese tariff names for the same HS-6.

changelog.note: v1.1.2：SIMA/AIM 进口许可改为 trade.gov 逐税号清单判定（AIM 16 组 67 个全表；SIMA 58 组 758 个全表，Ming 提供）；修复模块 10 表 7 行列错位（SIMA/AIM/FCC/ISF/AMS OR/EPA ODS/NMFS SIM 的豁免、状态、来源字段）。
changelog.note_en: v1.1.2: SIMA / AIM import licenses now decided from the trade.gov HTS-level lists (AIM 16 groups / 67 codes; SIMA 58 groups / 758 codes, full table provided by Ming); fixed 7 misaligned rows in the module 10 table (exemption, status and source fields of SIMA / AIM / FCC / ISF / AMS OR / EPA ODS / NMFS SIM).

changelog.note: v1.1.1：UFLPA 溯源文件清单改为 CBP Pub. 5560-0526（2026-06-09）附录 A（12 个行业）/ E（通用）/ F（例外申请）逐项原文转录；答复时限与看板统计（Pub. 5344-0126，至 2025-11-24）按原文核对。
changelog.note_en: v1.1.1: UFLPA traceability document lists transcribed item by item from CBP Pub. 5560-0526 (2026-06-09) appendices A (12 sectors) / E (general) / F (exception requests); response deadlines and dashboard statistics (Pub. 5344-0126, through 2025-11-24) verified against the source.

changelog.note: v1.1：新增其他监管要求层——UFLPA 实体清单 187 家 / 12 个高风险行业 / 溯源文件清单、58 项 WRO + 8 项 Finding、29 项非 flag 监管要求（FCC Covered List 2026-07 逆变器等）、PGA 37 项准备清单；结果页新增“其他监管要求”栏，新增“实体清单”页。
changelog.note_en: v1.1: new "other import requirements" layer — UFLPA Entity List (187 entities) / 12 priority sectors / traceability document lists, 58 WROs + 8 Findings, 29 non-flag requirements (FCC Covered List, inverters added 2026-07, etc.), 37 PGA preparation checklists; new "other import requirements" panel on the results page and a new "Entity List" tab.

changelog.note: 首版：8 个模块合并（HTSUS 2026 Rev.18）；叠加矩阵 v1；MPF FY2026/FY2027。
changelog.note_en: First release: 8 modules combined (HTSUS 2026 Rev.18); stacking matrix v1; MPF FY2026 / FY2027.
